page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 storage-oriented instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor within the Local SSDs family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz with two threads per core. Memory capacity is configured at 32.0 GB (4.0 GB per vCPU), backed by 33 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and AVX-512 instruction support. The instance includes 959 GB of local SSD storage, 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and does not include GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark outcomes show that compute and memory throughput remain largely in the lower quartile compared to broader cloud standards. Geekbench results return a single-core score of 953.0 and a multi-core score of 3596.0, aligned with stress-ng single-core (1104.48) and multi-core (5860.79) ratings in the bottom 25%. Memory write bandwidth for large blocks registers at an average 35.51 GB/sec, while read performance reaches 38.8 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates Redis throughput of 5.98 million SET operations per second and static web serving throughput of 4.55 GB/sec. CPU-based LLM inference handles small models reasonably at 98.7 tokens per second for generation, but degrades to 5.13 tokens per second on medium 7B models.

The primary value proposition of the ecs.i2g.2xlarge centers on its bundled 959 GB local SSD storage paired with dedicated Intel vCPUs. Although the CPU architecture is an older generation Xeon that trails in raw compute intensity and high-speed compression tasks, the attached high-speed local disk offloads I/O bottlenecks without requiring external block storage attachments. This resource balance makes it functional for local caching, non-relational datastores, logging nodes, and distributed database replicas that prioritize direct disk access over raw processing throughput.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is a storage-focused x86_64 virtual instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores, 32.0 GB of system memory, and 959 GB of integrated local SSD storage, accompanied by 2 Gbps baseline networking and zero GPUs. Benchmark profiles reveal moderate baseline memory write speeds (35.51 GB/sec) alongside weaker CPU computation scores, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 3596.0 and stress-ng multi-core performance of 5860.79. Because compute performance sits predominantly in the lower quartile, this configuration trades raw CPU compute for integrated high-capacity local disk space. It fits transactional data stores, search indexing nodes, Redis instances, and distributed database replicas requiring dedicated local storage rather than intense CPU compute.
